notes.title: Aaaaand...."The fall of Eskaria" is now free!
notes.content:
So, "The fall of Eskaria" is now free (for more information about why read previous post)

Thanks you all who purchased this game, played this game and will play this game. 

Don`t forget to wishlist "Charlie from the swamp" and play the demo!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1605150/Charlie_from_the_swamp/

notes.title: "The fall of Eskaria" becomes free!
notes.content:
Yes, you heard it right. "The fall of Eskaria" becomes free game (effective in a week after this post).
This was my first game, and although I`m happy with how it`s turned out and proud of myself, my mistakes in marketing and pricing became fatal at this point. 

I`d rather see people play the game for free, than not play at all. 

Thanks.

notes.title: Halloween deal is here!
notes.content:
"The Fall of Eskaria" is already pretty spooky (it's a game about a skeleton, if you forgot), but on Halloween it always became a little bit spookier! When else you have seen prices that low for the adorable indie platformers?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1339530

notes.title: Halloween spooky update!
notes.content: We made a big update for "The Fall of Eskaria"! New VFX, new collectibles, new beautiful assets, new reimagined gaming experience. Enjoy!
